course_name_original: Dynamique des fluides numérique / Computational Fluid Dynamics

learning_outcomes.text: To model simple systems involving fluid flow with or without heat transfer, with or without chemical reaction.
To use a software to set up a CFD study.
To extract relevant data (characteristics, performance, efficiency) from a system for its dimensioning.

syllabus_topics: General considerations on numerical fluid simulation.
CFD steps: geometry, meshing, parameterization, post-processing and validation.
Study of a system for aerodynamic, energetic and thermal applications.
bibliography: C. Hirsch, Numerical computation of internal and external flows : Fundamentals of Computational Fluid Dynamics. 2nd edition, Butterworth-Heinemann, 2007
J. Anderson, Computation Fluid Dynamics: the basics with applications, McGraw-Hill, 1995.
institution: ISAE-ENSMA (École nationale supérieure de mécanique et d'aérotechnique)
